definitions.full: H4573. Maadyah ַמעַדְיָה proper name, masculine a priest of Zerubbabel's time according to Neh 12:5 ; ᵐ5 . א Μααδιας , ᵐ5 L Μαασιας ; apparently = מוֺעַדְיָה 12:17 , ᵐ5 L Μασαι (etymology dubious; Thes puts below עדה = ornamentum Jovae , but properly ׳מֹע = ׳מוֺע , √ יעד = convenius Jovae ). מֹעֵד see מוֺעֵד below יעד . [ מַעֲדָן ], מַעֲדַנִּים see עדן .
